purpose: Dedicated airborne attacks; four approved skins, four moves per skin, four animation phases per move
normalization: One shared scale per complete sheet from its tall takeoff reference; manually reviewed pelvis anchors preserve body motion while knees bend. Alpha threshold and connected silhouettes, nearest-neighbour resizing, no redrawing.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production PIXEL ART airborne attack spritesheet for TIDE FIGHTERS.
Edit the transparent seed canvas into ONE exactly 4 columns by 4 rows sheet, SIXTEEN separate complete figures, equal square slots, 1792x1792 preferred. The existing approved in-game figure anchors identity and proportions. Reference 2 is its isolated seed. Character: Sui with silver-lavender twin tails, small BLACK CAT-EAR HAT, black and lilac cropped jacket, original dark strappy shorts, asymmetric fishnet and black knee boots. Preserve exactly the original costume in the seed.
ALL figures face RIGHT, consistent 3/4 side-view, same adult female body, head size, palette, outfit, crisp native pixel clusters and dark outline as seed. Match the seed's fairly realistic fighting-game body proportions; no chibi. Characters are fully AIRBORNE, no foot planted on an invisible ground. Hair and clothes trail with movement. Maintain same head-to-pelvis distance across every pose.
Rows from top to bottom, each row a four-frame animation ordered STARTUP / FULL EXTENSION ACTIVE / RECOIL / RECOVERY:
Row 1 LIGHT AIR PALM: tall airborne ready pose with rear leg extended down (a useful body-size reference), quick forward palm with one knee raised, retract palm, aerial guard. Legs remain visibly suspended and bent during action.
Row 2 MEDIUM AIR KICK: chamber knee, extend front leg horizontally right and fold rear leg, recoil knee, aerial guard.
Row 3 HEAVY DOWNWARD AIR KICK: coil both knees, powerful downward-right boot strike with upper body counterbalanced and rear leg tucked, recoil, recover knees. It must read distinctly from horizontal kick.
Row 4 AIR SPECIAL: diagonal flying cat-palm: crouch in midair, both palms thrust diagonally down-right while legs trail bent behind, then tuck and recover.
Keep the pelvis at the same position in each slot. Head/torso/limbs keep the seed's physical size. Leave ample transparent space for extended limbs, never crop hands/feet/hair and never shrink wide poses. Each entire silhouette independent and centered in its cell, 32px clear gutter, no overlapping silhouettes, no stray tiny artifacts.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no scenery, no shadows, no floor, no particles, no labels, no text, no watermark, no grid lines. All four frames of a row generated together for strong consistency.
